text:
Maya: hey team - urgent ask. I have a family emergency and need to be offline tomorrow morning (UTC) from 07:00-12:30. I'm the primary for the block that starts 06:00 UTC and ends 14:00 UTC. I can hand off the pager but need someone to be primary from 07:00-12:30. sorry for the last-minute ping :disappointed:

Sam: @Maya hope everything's okay. I can cover 07:00-10:30 UTC but then I have a calendar block. who's secondary during that block today?

Raj: @Sam I can take 10:30-13:30 UTC if that helps. between us we'd overlap 10:30-10:30 so fine.

Leah: I can be backup for the whole window in case anything is hot. I'll stay near my laptop.

Maya: thank you all. current roster shows: primary=Maya (06:00-14:00 UTC), secondary=Sam (06:00-14:00 UTC), on-call-owner queue is eng-oncall. But I'm asking for an explicit primary swap 07:00-12:30 while I'm OOO. Steps I usually do in handoff are below.

Maya: Handoff checklist (quick):
1) acknowledge and set on-call status in PagerDuty: `pd users change-ops --set-oncall maya -> sam` (replace with PD UI if you don't have CLI)
2) update Slack status and pin this thread to channel
3) run quick health checks: `curl -fsS https://status.redwood.internal/health || true` and `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide`
4) skim /runbooks/oncall/production-paging.md for active runbook notes
5) if a customer-impacting page, follow incident triage checklist: severity, affected customers, mitigation, comms.

Sam: copied. can you paste the PD escalation path? I don't have CLI perms.

Maya: sure — PD UI path: Services -> Redwood Inference - Prod -> Incidents -> Acknowledge -> Escalate. Primary should wake up secondary at +5m if no ack. For P1s: escalate to oncall-manager then Eng SRE pager. For P2s: notify slack #incidents and the customer success lead (cs-lead). Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/services/prod

incident-bot: ALERT: 1773508201 - Redis connection errors detected on runtime-gpu-02. Rate: 15m higher than baseline. Severity: P2. Pager sent to Maya. (This is an automated message)

Maya: I just got the Redis P2 - I can try to ack and triage but might be delayed. Whoever takes primary between 07:00-12:30 please take this one first — looks like transient connection spikes. Run the quick mitigation: restart the redis-client sidecar on runtime-gpu-02 and confirm KV cache warm.

Raj: I'll take primary starting 10:30 and will grab the Redis alert now. quick note: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/redis-client --selector=host=runtime-gpu-02` then watch `redis-cli --latency -h redis.prod` per runbook.

Sam: I'm taking 07:00-10:30 as agreed. I'll make the PD handoff at 07:00 UTC and pin the runbook. I'll also set my Slack status to "ONCALL (primary)".

Leah: I'll be available as backup and can loop in cs if we see customer latency > 300ms on embeddings. I'll also open a quick incident doc in Google Drive and add links here.

Maya: thanks all. small admin bits: please add a short note on the rota when you take the swap (ops-rotations-bot supports `/rota swap maya sam 2026-03-15 07:00 2026-03-15 12:30`), and tag me in the note if you can.

ops-rotations-bot: rota updated: Maya -> Sam (07:00-10:30 UTC), Maya -> Raj (10:30-12:30 UTC). Entry id: rota-20260315-42.

Sam: done the PD UI swap and set status. pinned this thread. also ran `curl` health check — status page returned OK.

Raj: I acknowledged the Redis alert and restarted the client on runtime-gpu-02. latency improved from ~420ms to ~90ms after restart. marking as mitigated per runbook. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if it recurs.

Maya: really appreciate you all stepping in. I'll keep my phone on in case of escalation but otherwise I'm offline for the morning. Please post any customer-impact updates here; I'll catch up later today. :heart:

Leah: noted. leaving a short note in the incident doc and watching metrics. pinging cs-lead in case any customers reach out. :eyes:

Sam: thanks @Raj & @Leah. if anything else pops up I'll escalate to eng-sre after 15m no ack.

Raj: all good from my side — will hand back to Maya at 12:30 UTC and remove myself from primary in PD then.

Maya: thank you again. I owe you :coffee: when I'm back.

Leah: get some rest, Maya. :pray:
